name: code-intel
description: Language-aware code intelligence for Codex: AST search, LSP navigation, preview-only refactors, and explicit fallback routing.

interface.shortDescription: Prefer AST/LSP code intelligence before text fallback.
interface.longDescription: Code Intel adds standalone Codex skills, an MCP server, adapter registry, optional soft hooks, and validation workflows so agents can use language-aware search, navigation, references, rename previews, rewrite previews, and post-edit diagnostics with explicit fallback reasons.
